Usage: demo list [options]

List configured items.

Options:
  -n, --limit <N>     Maximum number of items to show (default: 50)
  --format <FMT>      Output format: text, json or ndjson (default: text)
  --json              Emit machine-readable JSON
  --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
  --filter <PATTERN>  Only show items matching PATTERN

Exit code: 0 on success, 1 on error, 2 on usage error.
